description: HTTP requests captured during the recording, one line each: time, method, status, URL (query strings stripped), duration, type, size. No request/response bodies are captured. Sensitive headers are redacted.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

domain.description: Substring match on the request host.

include_headers.description: Include request (>) and response (<) headers. Default false.

recording.description: Traceo share link (e.g. https://www.traceo.dev/abc123...) or recording id.

status.description: "failed" (network error or >=400), "2xx", "3xx", "4xx", "5xx", or an exact code like "404".

type.description: Resource type, e.g. xhr, fetch, script.

name: get_network_requests
title: Get network requests
